intro: 12 個購物情境高頻字。每個字附兩個例句、中譯,以及用法與衍生字提醒。

ex.en: She bargained for over an hour, finally reducing the price by half.
ex.zh: 她討價還價了一個多小時,最後把價格砍了一半。

ex.en: Lois compared the sweaters carefully to determine which was a better bargain.
ex.zh: 蘿絲仔細比較這些毛衣,判斷哪一件比較划算。

note: bargain for / over sth 為⋯討價還價;a good bargain 划算的交易
bargaining 議價;bargain hunter 愛撿便宜的人

ex.en: Moya can't bear crowded stores so she does most of her shopping online.
ex.zh: 莫雅受不了擁擠的商店,所以她大部分的購物都在網路上完成。

ex.en: If you can bear with me, I'd like to stop in one more store.
ex.zh: 如果你能再忍耐我一下,我想再逛一家店。

note: bear with sb 容忍某人、耐心等候
另有承擔、生育、熊等意思

ex.en: Annu is conducting a survey on whether consumer behavior differs between men and women.
ex.zh: 安努正在進行一項調查,研究男性與女性的消費行為是否有所不同。

ex.en: Suspicious behavior in a department store will draw the attention of the security guards.
ex.zh: 在百貨公司裡可疑的行為會引起保全人員的注意。

words.zh: (超市等)結帳處;(旅館等)結帳離開的時間

ex.en: The line at this checkout is too long, so let's look for another.
ex.zh: 這個結帳櫃台排隊的人太多了,我們找另一個吧。

ex.en: This store has plenty of cashiers and checkout takes no time at all.
ex.zh: 這家店有很多收銀員,結帳一點都不費時間。

note: 名詞 checkout 寫在一起;動詞 check out 分開
checkout line 結帳隊伍;late checkout 延後退房

ex.en: Some people use shopping as a way to comfort themselves after a stressful day.
ex.zh: 有些人把購物當成壓力大的一天之後的自我安慰。

ex.en: I like to dress for comfort if I'm spending the day shopping.
ex.zh: 如果要花一整天逛街,我喜歡穿得舒服一點。

note: dress for comfort 穿著求舒適
comfortable 舒適的;uncomfortable 不舒服的

ex.en: The new manager has significantly expanded the store's inventory.
ex.zh: 新經理大幅增加了店內的庫存量。

ex.en: The shoe store is out of room, so the owners are expanding into the adjacent vacant building.
ex.zh: 這家鞋店已經沒有空間了,所以店主正往隔壁的空建築擴張。

note: expansion 擴張;expandable 可擴充的

ex.en: The collector likes to explore antique shops looking for bargains.
ex.zh: 這位收藏家喜歡逛古董店尋找便宜好貨。

ex.en: If you explore the Internet, you'll probably find the item you're looking for at a good price.
ex.zh: 如果你上網搜尋,很可能會用不錯的價錢找到你要的商品。

ex.en: The grocery store has a special checkout line for people who are purchasing fewer than ten items.
ex.zh: 這家雜貨店為購買少於十件商品的顧客設有專用結帳通道。

ex.en: Do you think I can get all these items into one bag?
ex.zh: 你覺得我能把這些東西全部裝進一個袋子嗎?

note: 可數名詞,所以用 fewer than ten items,不用 less
an item on the list 清單上的項目;news item 一則新聞

ex.en: The jewelry store has a mandatory policy of showing customers only one item at a time.
ex.zh: 這家珠寶店有項強制規定,一次只向顧客展示一件商品。

ex.en: There is a mandatory limit of nine items for use of this checkout line.
ex.zh: 這條結帳通道有九件商品的強制上限。

note: optional 選擇性的;voluntary 自願的

ex.en: I am very impressed with the quality of the merchandise on this website.
ex.zh: 這個網站上商品的品質讓我印象深刻。

ex.en: Helen made sure that the store had a wide variety of merchandise before buying a gift certificate.
ex.zh: 海倫在購買禮券前,先確認這家店有各式各樣的商品。

note: merchant 商人;merchandising 商品行銷

ex.en: Our store strictly enforces its return policy.
ex.zh: 我們店嚴格執行退貨政策。

ex.en: Their high turnover rate is no surprise, considering how strictly the manager deals with them.
ex.zh: 考慮到經理對待他們有多嚴格,他們的高離職率並不令人意外。

note: strictly speaking 嚴格說來;strictly forbidden 嚴禁

ex.en: The clothing store tries to stay on top of all the new trends.
ex.zh: 這家服飾店努力跟上所有新的潮流。

ex.en: Mioshi followed market trends closely before she bought a clothing franchise.
ex.zh: 米歐西在買下一家服飾加盟店之前,密切關注了市場趨勢。

note: follow / set a trend 追隨或引領潮流;market trend 市場趨勢
trendy 流行的;trendsetter 潮流引領者
